post_text:
Four Seasons has unveiled its Private Jet journey for 2028, with a European finale on the Riviera and in Hampshire.

The new itinerary, Coastlines & Culture, takes off on 6 May 2028 and lands on 26 May. Just 48 travellers, on a custom-configured Airbus A321neo-LR, with a concierge, an executive chef and a physician travelling with them.

The route: San Francisco, Seoul, Hangzhou on West Lake, a day in Shanghai, a cinnamon estate in Sri Lanka, Zanzibar, a yacht charter at Sharm El Sheikh. Then Europe: the @Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat, a yacht day to Cannes, and a finale at @Four Seasons Hotel Hampshire, with private access to Hampton Court Palace.

Five hotels join a Private Jet itinerary for the first time, Hampshire and Zanzibar among them. No price has been disclosed.

Behind the route, @Marc Speichert, Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer, says a new itinerary "requires immense thought and care". @Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is led by President and CEO @Alejandro Reynal. In Europe, the last two stops are run by General Managers @François-Régis Simon in Cap-Ferrat and @Andrew Harrison in Hampshire.

The signal: announced 18 months ahead, the trip turns hotels into chapters of one journey.

Which stop would make you book the whole trip?
